verdict.rationale: Ledgy's own marketing claims HRIS integrations that keep large volumes of data accurate, which suggests ongoing sync, and automated compliance error flags, so some product-run automation exists. The other 'automation' claims, such as bulk granting, document and signature workflows and one-click custom field sync, are user-triggered rather than autonomous background jobs. The service-account API is only a developer building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow rules, scheduled or triggered background jobs, explicit evidence that HRIS sync runs unattended, any agentic or autonomous execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
